title: Subscription Invoice Fetcher
summary: Matches each row of your invoice breakdown sheet to the matching invoice email in the admin Gmail inbox and gives you back a Status column plus a link to the saved attachment. You now sign in by typing the admin Gmail address and a Gmail App Password directly into the page instead of connecting through Google Cloud/OAuth.
prompt: Replace the current Google OAuth sign-in flow (which needs a Cloud Console app, GMAIL_CLIENT_ID/GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, and a redirect URI set up in advance) with a plain input field in the tool's own web page instead: an email address field and a Gmail App Password field (the 16-character password anyone can generate themselves from Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App Passwords, no developer setup needed). Use these two values to connect to the admin Gmail inbox over IMAP instead of the Gmail API/OAuth, and search for the invoice emails the same way as before. The app password field must be a masked password input, must never be written to disk or logged, and should only be held in memory for the current run (the user re-enters it each time they run the tool, same as they re-upload the sheet).
assumptions: The email address and app password are for the same admin Gmail inbox the tool already searched before this change - only the sign-in method changed, not which inbox is used
Whoever runs the tool generates the app password themselves beforehand; the tool does not walk through Google's app-password screen
2-Step Verification is enabled on the admin account outside this tool (a prerequisite for app passwords)
Matching logic (which emails count as a match, how the date window is chosen, output layout) is unchanged from the prior OAuth version, per the approved spec
Runs in an environment the user trusts - 'held in memory only' protects the app password from disk/log persistence, not from inspection of the running process's memory
expects: The invoice breakdown sheet as a .xlsx file with columns for enterprise/client name, a breakdown/description, an invoice date, and an amount (header wording can vary)
A Gmail App Password for that admin account (generate at Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App Passwords; 2-Step Verification must be turned on)

history.prompt: I have attached a template subscription invoice. Across every enterprise there is a breakdown against every break down i want the invoice gotten from the admin email around that date. The feature shall take admin account access and the invoice sheet and get invoices from the gmail against every break down.
